## Yoko Konishi

![[monoc-small.jpg]]

- [ICST Projektseite](https://www.zhdk.ch/forschung/icst/icst-air/yoko-konishi-25367)

From 24 August to September 13, 2026, Yoko Konishi will be at ICST for her ICST Studio Residency. She will develop a new work that will be showcased at the SONIC MATTER FESTIVAL 2027.
